notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
This patch includes:
[list]
[*] Saving and loading (FINALLY)
[*] Major optimization (Performs 4x faster)
[*] Fixed the glitch where killers can still roam while paused
[*] Fixed the game crash on level 3
[*] Changed some sfx
[/list]
